title: Nextbell: Calendar Alarms
shortDescription: Custom meeting alarms for Google Calendar, shared calendars and Google Tasks
fullDescription:
Get ready for your next meeting with Nextbell, a calendar alarm and reminder app for Google Calendar and Google Tasks.

Set a 10-minute heads-up, a 5-minute alarm, or your own reminder times. Keep personal, work and shared calendars together in a clear daily agenda.

CALENDAR ALARMS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
Choose reminders in minutes, hours or days. Use app-wide defaults, change them for a calendar, or set an exception for a recurring series or one meeting. Snooze for five minutes or dismiss the current alarm while keeping later reminders.

YOUR GOOGLE CALENDARS, TOGETHER
Connect multiple Google accounts and select calendars you can already access, including shared and subscribed calendars. Turn a calendar off, show its events without alarms, or enable alarms. Calendar access stays read-only: Nextbell never edits your meetings or Google's reminder settings.

GOOGLE TASKS WITH A TIME OF THEIR OWN
See your selected task lists beside your agenda. Tasks stay silent until you choose an alarm date and time. Complete a task in Nextbell and send its completion back to Google. Offline changes wait until you reconnect.

READY WHEN YOU TRAVEL
Meeting times display in your phone's current timezone. Reminders stay tied to the actual event time, helping you keep track across timezone changes. All-day events appear without automatic alarms.

PERSONAL BY DESIGN
Calendar content, task data and reminder preferences stay on your device. Already scheduled alarms can ring offline. There are no ads, analytics, subscriptions or Nextbell cloud accounts in this version.

A CLEARER WAY TO SEE YOUR DAY
Enjoy light and dark themes, rounded controls and small, playful animations. Large text, screen-reader labels and reduced motion are supported.

WHAT TO KNOW
Requires Android 8.0 or later, Google Play services and a Google account. An internet connection is needed to connect accounts and refresh changes. Allow notifications, alarms and full-screen alarm access for the intended experience. Background refresh and alarm delivery depend on Android permissions and device restrictions; force-stopping the app can prevent alarms until you open it again. Google Tasks provides dates rather than alarm times, so task alarms are set separately in Nextbell. Availability-only calendars can show anonymous busy blocks; they do not reveal meeting titles or links.

Nextbell is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
